name: just
description: Installs just, a handy way to save and run project-specific commands via justfile.

version.description: Version of just to install. Use 'latest' or an exact version like '1.51.0' (partial versions are not supported).

lspVersion.description: Version of just-lsp to install. Use 'latest' or an exact version like '0.4.5'. Set to 'false' to skip installation.
